basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Mangalagiri, Andhra Pradesh (an autonomous institute under MoHFW, Govt. of India) has re-advertised 26 Group A faculty posts in 17 departments on direct recruitment / deputation basis: 11 Professor, 5 Additional Professor, 6 Associate Professor and 4 Assistant Professor. The posts carry pay from Level 12 to Level 14-A of the Pay Matrix. Online applications open on 20 November 2026 and close on 31 December 2026, and the signed hard copy must reach the Recruitment Cell by 10 January 2027.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only through the online mode on the AIIMS Mangalagiri website (www.aiimsmangalagiri.edu.in), followed by sending the required documents. The online form opens on 20 November 2026 and closes on 31 December 2026.
Keep ready a valid e-mail ID, a scanned passport size photograph (JPG format), a scanned signature (JPG format) and online payment details for the application fee.
Fill in the online application form as per the procedure given on the online application portal of the institute website, and take a printout.
Pay the application fee online. For more than one post, apply separately online for each post and pay the fee for each post.

Sign the printout and send it with all certificates and documents by Speed Post / Courier etc. so that it reaches the Institute within 10 days of the closing date of the online application, i.e. by 10 January 2027.
Write on the envelope: "Application for the post of ____ in the Department of ____".
Address for the hard copy: Recruitment Cell, Room No. 205, 2nd Floor, Library & Admin Building, AIIMS, Mangalagiri, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh – 522503.
Also send the self-attested documents as a single PDF document to [email protected].

Fill the List of Enclosures (Annexure-I) and the Brief of the candidate (Annexure-II), which all candidates must fill. The annexures can be downloaded in Word format from https://www.aiimsmangalagiri.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Annexure-I-II-1.docx.
If the hard copy does not reach within the stipulated period, the candidature will not be considered for the applied post. Incomplete applications in any aspect will be summarily rejected.
The application fee once remitted will not be refunded under any circumstances.
A duly constituted Standing Selection Committee conducts the selection for all the posts. Interviews will be held at AIIMS Mangalagiri, in a mode decided by the Executive Director, AIIMS Mangalagiri.

Candidates called for interview must produce all relevant original documents for verification before the interview. They may also be asked to submit an affidavit / declaration, as decided by AIIMS Mangalagiri at the time of interview.
After document verification, the Standing Selection Committee conducts the interview / selection process only for eligible candidates against the post they applied for.

Candidates must score the minimum qualifying marks (suitability standard) in the interview for empanelment in order of merit: UR/EWS 50%, OBC 45%, SC/ST 40%, and PwBD as per applicable category relaxation. Candidates below these marks will not be considered irrespective of merit position.
Appearing in the interview does not confer any right to selection.
The notice does not give an interview date.

Deputation applicants also submit the online application, then forward the printout through proper channel with documents on Date of Birth, Education Qualifications, Experience, No Objection Certificate, Vigilance Clearance Certificate and APAR/ACR for the last 05 years.
The application must reach the Recruitment Cell address above within 10 (Ten) days of the last date of online submission, otherwise it will not be considered.
The envelope is to be super-scribed "Application for the Post of ……… on Deputation basis in the Dept. Of ………".

Duly attested photocopies of APAR/ACR Reports for the last 05 years must be enclosed. No vigilance / disciplinary proceedings should be pending or contemplated against the candidate, and applications without vigilance clearance and APAR/ACR dossiers will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Mangalagiri
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Mangalagiri, Guntur Dist., Andhra Pradesh, is an Autonomous Institute of National Importance. The notice describes it as one of the new AIIMS and apex healthcare institutes being established by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY). Its stated aim is to correct regional imbalance in quality tertiary level healthcare and to attain self-sufficiency in graduate, postgraduate and higher medical education and training.

The vacancies are provisional and subject to variation, and the Executive Director, AIIMS Mangalagiri reserves the right to vary the vacancies, including reserved vacancies, as per Govt. of India Rules / Circulars and requirements. A * mark means the 4% horizontal reservation post is reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD). A # mark means a newly added vacancy. Reservation for PwBDs is as per GoI guidelines, and reservation does not apply to posts filled on deputation basis.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The pay levels are as given in MoH&FW (INI-I-Section), GoI Letter No. V-16020/28/2017-INI-I (Pt.), dated 23rd August 2018. The pay is the same for posts on direct recruitment and deputation basis. All the posts carry usual allowances as admissible to Central Government Employees of similar status at AIIMS Mangalagiri. The appointment will be subject to review and probation of two years. A faculty member, after rendering fixed years of service on a grade, may be considered for assessment promotion, subject to the Rules and Regulations applicable from time to time. The appointee shall be on the whole-time appointment of AIIMS Mangalagiri and shall not accept any other assignment, paid or otherwise, or engage in private practice of any kind. Deputation: the initial period is 03 years, further extendable as per DoPT regulations, and it is governed by the standard DoPT terms (OMs dated 17 June 2010, 17 February 2016 and 23 February 2017, as amended). Service under the Institute is governed by the Act of Parliament under which AIIMS Mangalagiri is established and the Rules and Regulations framed under it.

Candidates claiming PwBD reservation need a Disability Certificate issued by a competent authority in the prescribed format; reservation is for persons with not less than 40% of physical disability. DNB holders need documentary evidence of DNB equivalence from the competent authority.

faq.question: Q1. How many faculty vacancies are there in AIIMS Mangalagiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 26 posts: 11 Professor, 5 Additional Professor, 6 Associate Professor and 4 Assistant Professor across 17 departments. The notice says the vacancies are provisional and subject to variation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 31 December 2026, having opened on 20 November 2026. The signed hard copy must reach the Recruitment Cell by 10 January 2027.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Medical candidates need the medical qualification under the Indian Medical Council Act of 1956 and a postgraduate qualification (e.g. MD/MS or equivalent) with three years of teaching/research experience, or D.M./M.Ch. for super specialty with one year (none for a 3 years recognized D.M./M.Ch.). Non-medical candidates need a postgraduate qualification and a Doctorate with three years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The limit is not exceeding 58 years for Professor and Additional Professor, and not exceeding 50 years for Associate Professor and Assistant Professor, as on the closing date of the online application. Relaxation is 10 years for PwBD, 5 years for SC/ST on reserved posts, 3 years for OBC on reserved posts and 5 years for Government servants.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for AIIMS Mangalagiri faculty posts?
faq.answer: Minimum pay is Rs.1,68,900 (Level 14-A) for Professor, Rs.1,48,200 (Level 13-A2+) for Additional Professor, Rs.1,38,300 (Level 13-A1+) for Associate Professor and Rs.1,01,500 (Level 12) for Assistant Professor. NPA is added for medically qualified candidates only.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: UR/EWS/OBC candidates pay Rs. 3100 in total (Rs. 3,000 plus Rs. 100 processing fee), and SC/ST/Women pay Rs. 2100 (Rs. 2000 plus Rs. 100). PwBD candidates pay only the Rs. 100 processing fee, and the fee is not refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for AIIMS Mangalagiri faculty posts?
faq.answer: Fill the online form on www.aiimsmangalagiri.edu.in and take a printout. Send the signed hard copy with documents by Speed Post / Courier to the Recruitment Cell, AIIMS Mangalagiri, and e-mail the self-attested documents as one PDF to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: A Standing Selection Committee conducts the selection through an interview at AIIMS Mangalagiri, after verification of original documents. Candidates must score at least 50% (UR/EWS), 45% (OBC) or 40% (SC/ST) in the interview, with PwBD as per applicable category relaxation.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates who wish to apply for more than one post must apply separately online for each post and pay the application fee for each post.

faq.question: Q10. Are the posts open on deputation, and for how long?
faq.answer: Yes, the posts are advertised on direct recruitment / deputation basis, and reservation does not apply to deputation posts. The initial period of deputation is 03 years, further extendable as per DoPT regulations.
